extracted.name: Fish Seasoning - for any fish
extracted.description: Recipe video above. This is a great spice seasoning for fish that makes for a quick and easy way to add flavour to fish. Based on Old Bay Seasoning, it's a combination of spices that works really well together. I've used flathead fillets today, but it can be used for any fish suitable for pan-frying. Don't worry if you don't have all the spices, there's plenty of subs. Allow ~180g/6oz fish per person.
ingredient_lines: 1/8 tsp cayenne pepper ((or pure chilli powder))
750g / 1.5lb fish fillets (, skinless, boneless (I used flathead, Note 2))
30g / 2 tbsp Extra unsalted butter – for drizzling ((optional))
instruction_lines: Fish Seasoning: Place ingredients in a bowl and mix to combine. It will keep for months in an airtight container. This quantity is enough for 750g / 1.5lb fish (serves 4 people)
Season fish: Sprinkle Seasoning on both sides of fish. Lightly rub to spread Seasoning.
Cook fish in two batches: Melt 30g / 2tbsp butter in large non-stick skillet over medium high heat. Cook fish until golden on each side (see Cook times below). Remove to a plate.
Cook remaining fish: Melt remaining butter in skillet and cook remaining fish.
Rest: Rest fish for 3 minutes before serving with extra butter sauce (see next step).
Extra butter sauce (optional): Add extra butter into pan over medium heat and melt until foaming. Drizzle over fish when serving.
